title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-06-24
lineage: Audience master > ?? > Reel(Mono, Scotch 7" reel @ 3&3/4ips) > Alesis Masterlink ML-9600 > CDR > EAC(secure, offset corrected) > Cool Edit Pro > TLH > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Low‑fidelity audience tape with muddy sound; St. Stephen’s performance sparks criticism and only limited praise.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture that suffers from sub‑par sound quality, making the mix unclear. Reviewers are divided on the show – one calls the rendition of “St. Stephen” the worst ever, another defends it but still notes the audio isn’t great, and a third offers only a vague comment. Overall the performance is seen as underwhelming, especially given the poor recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Both show and recording are judged poorly by reviewers; limited positive feedback keeps the overall rating low but not at the absolute bottom.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound quality described as 'not too good' with noticeable muddiness, typical of an audience source.
